hero.title: Compete with friends predicting football matches
hero.subtitle: Create your free sports {term} and have fun predicting football results with your friends.

whatIs.title: What is Picks4All?
whatIs.p1: Picks4All is the free platform to create sports pools online and compete with friends, family, or coworkers by predicting football results. Known as polla futbolera in Colombia, prode in Argentina, penca in Uruguay, or porra in Spain.
whatIs.p1WorldCup: Picks4All is the free platform to create sports pools online and compete with friends, family, or coworkers by predicting football results. Known as polla futbolera in Colombia, prode in Argentina, penca in Uruguay, or porra in Spain.
whatIs.p2: Create your {term} for free (up to 20 players), invite anyone with a code, make your predictions and compete on the leaderboard. Free and with no gambling — just fun and friendly rivalry.

features.title: Everything you need to compete
features.subtitle: A complete platform to organize sports {plural} with friends, family, or coworkers.

feature1.title: Create your {term} in minutes
feature1.description: Customize rules, scoring system, and deadlines. Choose between exact score, match result, goal difference, and more. You decide how your {term} is played.

feature2.title: Real-time leaderboard
feature2.description: Rankings automatically updated after every match. See who's leading, compare your position, and follow the competition live with detailed stats.

feature3.title: Multiple scoring modes
feature3.description: Exact score, correct result, goal difference, streak bonus. Configure the scoring system that best fits your group.

feature4.title: Invite by link or WhatsApp
feature4.description: Share an invitation code via WhatsApp, Telegram, or any social network. Your friends join in seconds, no need to create an account beforehand.

feature5.title: Automatic results
feature5.description: Scores are automatically updated when each match ends. No need to enter results manually — we take care of it.

feature6.title: Email notifications
feature6.description: Reminders before each deadline, result summaries, and ranking updates. Your players are always in the loop.

feature7.title: Multi-tournament
feature7.description: World Cup, Champions League, Copa América, local leagues, and more. Create {plural} for any competition and manage multiple tournaments at once.

feature8.title: Mobile optimized
feature8.description: Designed to work perfectly on your phone. Make predictions, check the leaderboard, and manage your pool from anywhere.
